description: Search and list SEC filings by company (CIK), form type, date range, 8-K item codes and excluded forms, optionally with a full-text query over filing bodies and by company facts (market cap, float, price, sector, industry, exchange, company type, foreign issuer, recent IPO). Rows carry `id` (the internal filingId used by the filing-document and exhibit tools), cik, company_name, accession_number, form_type, filing_date, acceptedAt, primaryDocument, bodyStored and itemNumbers (plus `rank` and `snippet` with `q`); `pagination` has `total`, `totalRelation` ("eq" exact; "gte" a lower bound cut at 10,000, when `totalEstimate` is "about N"), `hasMore` and `nextCursor`. The `ciks` filter matches the filing's own CIK: a Form 4 filed under the reporting owner's CIK is not returned for the issuer's CIK. Coverage: Signal8's SEC EDGAR archive, updated through the day, in its held range (see `archiveFrom` in each response; currently from late 2021, expanding back to 2016 as the history backfill fills in). Before archiveFrom it holds only a scatter, so absence before archiveFrom is not evidence a filing was never filed; SEC EDGAR itself covers earlier periods. Record-only rows (bodyStored: false) have no stored body; the document is at its sec.gov URL. Every response carries `archiveFrom` and `rangeStartsBeforeArchive`: a range with no dateFrom or starting before archiveFrom is not definitive (`searchIndex.complete: false`, `reason: "outside_held_range"`, `heldFrom`): an empty result then means the archive holds no match from archiveFrom onward, not that no such filing exists. An empty text result is definitive only when `searchIndex.complete` is true. Full-text `q`: Query syntax: unquoted words all have to appear (any order, any distance); "quoted phrase" = exact wording; OR between alternatives (merger OR acquisition); -word or -"phrase" to exclude; w1 NEAR/10 w2 (also NEAR(10), or bare NEAR = within 10) = words close together; word* = prefix of 4+ letters (dilut* matches dilution, dilutive); $AAPL or a capitalised ticker scopes to that company; a form code (8-K, 10-Q, S-1), "item 5.02" / "8-K 1.05" and a bare year (2024) scope to that form / 8-K item / year. The archive's reading of the query is in `meta.understanding` (understand=false searches the words literally). facets=true adds `facets` per form / year / 8-K item over the whole result set (absent = not measured, never zero). sort=relevance caps page 1 per company; meta.diversity {maxPerCompany, hidden} names who has more (page with nextCursor or filter by CIK). section / exhibitTypes filters apply only when meta.sections / appliedFilters confirm them; otherwise meta.unsupported says why and the whole filing was searched. Company filters (minMarketCap … recentIpo): only issuer-filed forms are searched (third-party Form 4 / 144 / 13D/G go to `companyFilter.droppedForms` unless `companyFilter.subjectMatch` is true; with no formTypes the default is 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1, S-3, DEF 14A, 20-F, 40-F, 6-K); companies with no measured value are excluded, never assumed (`companyFilter.unknown` counts them); an unknown value is a 400 listing allowed names; when the archive cannot answer, the call fails with COMPANY_FILTER_NOT_APPLIED and never returns unfiltered rows; results are cursor-paged, cannot combine with acceptedFrom/acceptedTo/bodyStored, and carry no snippet. Results are filings, not a company list or count.

ciks.description: Comma-separated CIK numbers to filter by (e.g., "320193,1018724"; zero-padded also accepted)

companyTypes.description: Company filter. Comma-separated: operating, fund (registered funds/ETFs; adds N-CSR, N-CEN, N-PX, 485BPOS, 497/497K to the default forms), spac (blank-check companies)

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response's pagination.nextCursor. Stable for deep paging while new filings arrive (page is not). Required for page 2+ of a company-filtered search.

dateFrom.description: Start filing date (YYYY-MM-DD). The archive only holds filings from its `archiveFrom` date (stated in every response; currently late 2021, expanding back to 2016): omitting dateFrom, or starting earlier, makes an empty result non-definitive.

exchanges.description: Company filter. Comma-separated listing venues: NASDAQ, NYSE, AMEX (= NYSE American), OTC

excludeForms.description: Comma-separated form types to exclude (e.g., "4,13F-HR"). Exact match.

exhibitTypes.description: Keeps only filings carrying any of these exhibit types (comma-separated): a family such as EX-10 (material contracts) matches every member (EX-10.1, EX-10.2…); an exact type such as EX-99.1 (usually the press release) only itself. Others: EX-97 clawback policy, EX-3 charter/bylaws, EX-4 instruments/warrants, EX-21 subsidiaries, EX-23 consents. "10.1" is accepted for EX-10.1. Listed in appliedFilters when the rows prove it; otherwise in ignoredFilters / meta.unsupported, and the rows are then unfiltered.

facets.description: true = also return `facets`: { forms, years, items }, each a list of { value, count } over the whole result set (not just this page). Present only when the archive measured them (its OpenSearch engine); absent means not measured, not zero. Default false.

foreignIssuer.description: Company filter. true = companies with foreign-issuer evidence (a 20-F, 40-F or 6-K seen, or an ADR listing); false = none seen since the evidence log began (companyFilter.foreignEvidenceSince)

formTypes.description: Comma-separated form types (e.g., "10-K,10-Q,8-K,S-1,S-3,424B5"). Exact match; amendments (e.g. "10-K/A") match only when listed. (With company filters, amendments are added automatically.)

industries.description: Company filter. Industry names separated by "|", exact and case-sensitive (e.g. "Biotechnology|Airlines, Airports & Air Services"; some names contain ", ", so "|" is the safe separator; a bare comma with no space after it also separates). An unknown name returns a 400 listing every valid industry.

items.description: Comma-separated 8-K item codes, all required (e.g., "2.02,9.01" = results + financial statements; "5.02" = officer/director changes; "1.01" = material agreements; "3.01" = delisting notice).

match.description: Word matching for q. exact = a word matches only itself ("split" does not match "splits" or "splitting"), which is EDGAR full-text search's own behaviour; stemmed = English word variations also match. Default when omitted: stemmed. The mode actually applied is in the response's meta.matchMode (with meta.matchModeFallbackReason when it differs from the one asked for); meta.engine names the search engine. Ignored without q.

matchedSections.description: Per-row `matchedSections` (default true): the sections the text matched in. Absent on a row means not measured (index without sections), not "matched nowhere". Ignored without q.

maxFloat.description: Company filter. Maximum public float, in shares

maxMarketCap.description: Company filter. Maximum market cap in USD, e.g. 300000000 for under $300M

maxPrice.description: Company filter. Maximum latest share price in USD

minFloat.description: Company filter. Minimum public float, in shares

minMarketCap.description: Company filter. Minimum market cap in USD (price × shares outstanding), e.g. 50000000 for $50M

minPrice.description: Company filter. Minimum latest share price in USD

page.description: Page number (1-indexed, default: 1). Ignored when cursor is set; not allowed with company filters.

q.description: Full-text query over filing bodies. Query syntax: unquoted words all have to appear (any order, any distance); "quoted phrase" = exact wording; OR between alternatives (merger OR acquisition); -word or -"phrase" to exclude; w1 NEAR/10 w2 (also NEAR(10), or bare NEAR = within 10) = words close together; word* = prefix of 4+ letters (dilut* matches dilution, dilutive); $AAPL or a capitalised ticker scopes to that company; a form code (8-K, 10-Q, S-1), "item 5.02" / "8-K 1.05" and a bare year (2024) scope to that form / 8-K item / year. Example: '$AAPL "share repurchase" -"no longer"', 'cyber* NEAR/10 incident', 'item 5.02 resign*'.

recentIpo.description: Company filter. true = first listed within the last 365 days, with no evidence of earlier public status (renames and relistings are excluded). false is the same as omitting it.

section.description: Restricts matching to sections (comma-separated): business, risk_factors, cybersecurity, legal_proceedings, mdna, market_risk, controls (10-K/10-Q/20-F narrative items, by meaning: mdna is 10-K Item 7, 10-Q Part I Item 2 and 20-F Item 5), ex99 (press-release / EX-99.x exhibit text) and item_X_YY (the text under an 8-K item, e.g. item_5_02). Aliases: mda, risk, legal, cyber, press_release, 5.02. Unknown names are a 400. Requires q. Applied only when the response's meta.sections names it; otherwise meta.unsupported says why (e.g. the archive index does not have sections yet) and matches may come from anywhere in the filing.

sectors.description: Company filter. Sector names separated by "|" (or a bare comma), exact and case-sensitive (e.g. "Healthcare|Technology"). An unknown name returns a 400 listing every valid sector.

sort.description: newest (by acceptance time, default) or relevance (requires q; best match first)

understand.description: Query understanding (default true): the archive recognises tickers/$TICKER, company names, form codes, "item N.NN" and expands synonyms, reporting what it applied in meta.understanding. false = search the words literally (also disables synonym expansion). Ignored without q.

name: search_sec_filings
title: Search SEC Filings
